title_zh: 核对垂钓活动的会合时间

scenario.label_zh: 确认运河垂钓活动集合安排
scenario.goal_zh: 核对活动说明会时间和无法出席者并确定会合地点

context_zh: 两位朋友确认已报名的虚构运河垂钓活动安排，不涉及钓法或许可建议。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Is everyone still coming to the fishing session on Sunday?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Everyone except Ravi. He has to work.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: He was going to drive us. How will we get there now?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Fortunately, there's a bus that stops outside the visitor centre.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Does it arrive before the organizer's briefing?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Yes, at nine twenty. The briefing starts at half past.

sentences.speaker: Marta
sentences.text: Then let's meet at the bus stop at eight forty-five. I'll tell the organizer there'll be one fewer person.
